outfit.name: 雾灰双排扣长风衣与绯红高领
outfit.prose: A tailored mist-grey knee-length double-breasted trench coat cinched with a black leather waist belt over a fitted crimson ribbed turtleneck knit and a sleek black pencil skirt, accessorized with a rectangular silver wristwatch, sheer black tights, and low-heeled black chelsea boots.
